# Content extraction baseline

The screenshots capture the approved specimen before extraction, at blog commit
`3b7ab95` (2026-10-14). Desktop: 1440×1000. Mobile: 390×844.

The specimen lives in `site/content/content-demo.ru.md`. Use `make content-demo`
to compare the migrated renderer with these reference images. Site navigation,
comments, and poetry layout remain host-owned; the independent module example
uses a different UI monospace font because CourierCyr is not redistributed.
